known_limitations: lzbench exercises Zstd with ZSTD_compress2 while this plan-required adapter exercises the same vendored implementation through its streaming frame API and explicit end loop.
This registered variant is scalar, single-threaded, dictionary-free, and disables legacy decoding and assembly; those modes require separate execution variants.
The project wrapper currently performs one update per independently finalized object and does not claim streaming/query capability.
The Python FFI descriptor serialization and contiguous byte materialization are included in the declared adapter boundary.
LeakSanitizer cannot run under the host container ptrace policy; ASan/UBSan qualification uses detect_leaks=0.
